name: s2k_addLoadCaseToLoadComb
formula: =LAMBDA(loadCombName,caseName,scaleFactor,TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "ComboName=" & CHAR(34) & loadCombName & CHAR(34), "CaseName=" & CHAR(34) & caseName & CHAR(34), "ScaleFactor=" & scaleFactor))
comment: Create text regarding load combination data (add a load case/ load combination to a load combination) in SAP2000 $2k format. Last Update at 2024-07-11.
